profile.name: Abdul Motalab
profile.pitch: QA Engineer in Bangladesh with 4.5 years of experience in software testing, regression, and API testing. I find the bugs users would have found, and help teams ship software they can trust.
profile.aboutTitle: Quality is a team habit, not a last step.
about: I'm a QA Engineer with 4.5 years of experience in software testing. I care about clear requirements, early feedback, and bug reports that developers can act on without a back-and-forth.
At Ding, I work closely with developers and product teams to keep releases reliable.

services.title: Functional & regression testing
services.text: Verifying features against requirements and protecting existing behaviour with every release.

services.title: Test planning & design
services.text: Turning requirements into clear test cases that cover happy paths, edge cases, and failure modes.

services.title: API testing
services.text: Checking endpoints, payloads, and status codes so problems are caught before they reach the UI.

services.title: Bug reporting & triage
services.text: Reproducible, well-documented reports with severity and impact, so fixes happen faster.
